message:
You know that feeling when you’re all cozy at home, and the power goes out? I’ve been there, and it’s not as fun as it sounds! I always like to be prepared for those little surprises, so I found a great resource from the Red Cross on how to handle power outages. It covers everything from keeping your food safe to making sure you have the right supplies on hand. I’ve got my flashlight and snacks ready, and I’m feeling pretty smug about it! 

What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a blackout? 💡
